title: Numbers & arithmetic
code:
loot x = 10
loot y = 3

announce(x + y)
announce(x - y)
announce(x * y)
announce(x / y)
announce(x % y)

title: Loops & break/continue
code:
loot n = 0
grind (n < 20)
    n = n + 1
    when (n % 3 != 0)
        continue
    finish
    when (n > 15)
        break
    finish
    announce(n)
finish

title: Arrays & bounds checking
code:
loot nums = array_new(5)
nums[0] = 10
nums[1] = 20
nums[2] = 30

announce(length(nums))
announce(nums)
announce(nums[1])

announce(nums[10])

title: Strings
code:
loot first = "Hello"
loot second = "World"
loot greeting = first + ", " + second + "!"

announce(greeting)
announce(length(greeting))
announce(first == "Hello")
announce(first == second)
